## Architectural Methodology & Engineering Pillars

### 1. Zero Cold-Start Audio ML & Event Streaming
- **Implementation:** Decoupling real-time acoustic feature extraction from multi-horizon storage.
- **Topology:** Streaming signed audio URLs into memory without saving raw files to disk; running 13 ONNX models (BPM, key, mood, valence/arousal, genre, 256d & 1280d acoustic embeddings, duplicate detection).
- **Data Pipeline:** Qdrant (256d vector search) + PostgreSQL (1280d profiles) paired with Kafka buffering play, skip, and like signals into ClickHouse (ALS collaborative filtering) and Valkey (live session state) to solve cold-start for newly uploaded tracks from song #1.

### 2. Schema-per-Tenant Isolation & Zero-Trust RBAC
- **Implementation:** Strict database isolation where each tenant operates within its dedicated PostgreSQL schema (`tenant_<subdomain>`).
- **Context Injection:** Tenant context bound via Node.js `AsyncLocalStorage` within custom NestJS middleware, eliminating request-scoped dependency injection overhead.
- **Security:** Privilege escalation prevented at the API boundary (403 Forbidden for root super-admin registration); root administration seeded strictly through secure CLI scripts.

### 3. Local-First Mobile & Multi-Provider AI Adapters
- **Implementation:** Offline-first architecture built with React Native and Expo Router, powered by embedded SQLite with versioned DDL migrations.
- **AI Resilience:** Runtime multi-provider AI adapters supporting Groq, OpenAI, Google Gemini, and OpenRouter, paired with deterministic Whisper STT hallucination filters and SM-2 Lite spaced repetition scheduling.
- **Cross-Platform Delivery:** Single TypeScript codebase compiled for Google Play Android (AAB/APK) and static web deployments.

### 4. Deterministic Media Automation & Zero-Dependency Tooling
- **Implementation:** Automated programmatic pipelines with strict post-render QA gates.
- **Audio DSP:** WAV rhythm analysis outputting millisecond-accurate `beats.json` driving Remotion programmatic React video rendering across multiple aspect ratios (9:16 vertical reels and billboard displays).
- **System Tooling:** Zero-dependency CLI tools utilizing pure Node.js 18+ built-ins to measure TCP/TLS latency, jitter, and throughput against edge endpoints.

## Production Systems & Architecture Ledger

### 01. MusicAI — Distributed Audio Profiler & Recommendation Engine
- **Category:** Distributed AI & ML
- **Role:** Co-Engineered with Engineering Team (Original Concept & Lead Architect, 3-Engineer Core Team)
- **Target Integrations:** Major streaming platforms in Turkmenistan (Belet Music, Sazz, Aydym.com, Hinlen) via decoupled HTTP REST APIs.
- **Architecture:**
  - Audio Profiler (`:8001`): Streams signed audio URLs in-memory → 13 ONNX models.
  - Recommendation Engine (`:8002`): Powers Recommended For You, Discover, Today’s Mood, and Infinite Radio.
  - Telemetry & Inspector (`:8080`): Live audio inspection and recommendation debugging portal.
- **Tech Stack:** Python 3.12 (uv, ruff, mypy strict), FastAPI, ONNX Runtime (13 Models), Qdrant Vector DB, Apache Kafka, ClickHouse (ALS), Valkey, PostgreSQL, Docker Compose (~8 GB RAM footprint).

### 02. WaaS — B2B Multi-Tenant Platform & Storefront Engine
- **Category:** B2B SaaS & Systems
- **Role:** Solo Full-Stack & Database Architect
- **Production API:** https://waas-api-demo-e67aa57945a7.herokuapp.com/docs
- **Architecture:** Subdomain / `x-tenant-id` → `TenantMiddleware` → `AsyncLocalStorage` context → `BaseTenantRepository` executing `SET LOCAL search_path TO "tenant_<slug>", public`.
- **Supported Engines:** ECOMMERCE_STORE, ARTIST_PORTFOLIO (quotes), PROMOTIONAL_LANDING (WhatsApp ordering).
- **Tech Stack:** NestJS v11, Fastify, TypeORM, PostgreSQL (Schema-per-Tenant), React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Heroku.

### 06. Neural ASR & Acoustic TTS Pipeline
- **Category:** Distributed AI & ML
- **Role:** University AI Research Lead (Confidential R&D)
- **Architecture:** Native speech recognition and speech synthesis models engineered from scratch for low-resource Turkic phonetics.
- **ASR Engine:** 41,754,049 parameter FastConformer-style CTC recognizer (8x depthwise subsampling, 12 Conformer blocks, 1,024-piece SentencePiece Unigram tokenizer) in native PyTorch 2.x.
- **TTS Engine:** 230-hour curated acoustic speech synthesis dataset with phoneme alignment and custom DSP vocoder.
- **Verification:** 90/90 unit and distributed multi-process PyTorch DDP verification tests passed.

### 07. Google Flow + Remotion Ad Video Pipeline
- **Category:** Distributed AI & ML
- **Role:** Automation & Creative Systems Architect
- **Architecture:** 7-stage programmatic video pipeline transforming client `brief.json` into broadcast-ready 9:16 vertical Reels and billboard advertising.
- **DSP Engine:** Custom WAV audio beat detector outputting frame-accurate `beats.json` driving 4 dynamic Remotion templates with automated FFprobe QA auditing.
- **Tech Stack:** Remotion, Google Flow AI, TypeScript, Audio Beat DSP, Node.js MJS, FFmpeg, FFprobe.

### 08. AI Photo Studio SaaS Platform

### 09. OSAI — Japanese Speaking AI Partner

### 10. OwnSpeedtest — Zero-Dependency Network CLI
- **Category:** B2B SaaS & Systems (Open Source)
